title: GTA6 PS5 Limited Edition Controllers Pre-Order Guide
description: Sony and Rockstar team up for GTA6 limited edition PS5 controllers in black and white. Get the latest pre-order details and design breakdown.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Limited Edition PS5 Controllers Available for Pre-Order

As the highly anticipated release date of Grand Theft Auto VI draws closer, Sony and Rockstar Games have officially teamed up to offer fans two limited-edition PS5 controllers themed around the upcoming blockbuster. According to gaming media outlet Push Square, pre-order links for these collectible peripherals have gone live in the US and UK.

Set to launch ahead of and alongside the main title, these controllers provide fans with a tangible way to gear up for their return to the franchise's iconic setting. With high demand expected for any official hardware tied to the GTA franchise, securing a pre-order early will be crucial for collectors and enthusiasts alike.

## Design Breakdown and Aesthetic Features

The limited-edition collection features two distinct colorways: a sleek black version and a clean white version. Both controllers share a set of custom design elements that capture the visual identity of GTA6:

* **Blue and Purple Faceplates**: Surrounding both thumbsticks and the touchpad, a striking blue and purple faceplate provides a vibrant contrast reminiscent of neon-drenched cityscapes.
* **Official Logo Integration**: The distinctive GTA6 logo is prominently printed directly onto the touchpad, marking its official collaboration status.
* **Palm Tree Textures**: Both handles feature subtle palm tree indentations, a thoughtful design touch that nods to the tropical, coastal vibes associated with the game's setting.

## Release Date and Availability

Both the black and white limited-edition controllers are scheduled to launch on **19th November 2026**—the exact same day the game officially drops. Fans looking to secure their units can check the currently available pre-order links in the US and UK regions.

Given the massive hype surrounding the game, availability for these limited hardware items is expected to be tight around the launch window. Players are advised to monitor official channels and retail pages to ensure they don't miss out on the release.

## Editor's Take

These limited-edition controllers strike a great balance between subtle style and fan service. The neon-inspired accents and palm tree textures offer a nice thematic nod without being overly distracting. For dedicated fans looking to deck out their setup for November 19, this is a must-have collectible.
